infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Pocket Doc needs camera access to capture document photos for your personal document library. All processing is done locally on your device for maximum privacy.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pocket Doc needs photo library access to select and upload images as documents. No data is shared externally - everything stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Pocket Doc uses Face ID to securely authenticate and protect access to your personal documents stored locally on your device.
